place.name: NS monument (Norway)
place.description: The NS monument, or Nasjonal Samling monument, was a Norwegian 9-metre (30 ft) tall obelisk made from quartzite shale from Vågå Municipality in Norway. It was erected at Stiklestad in Nord-Trøndelag county in July 1944 and inaugurated by collaborationist Minister-President Vidkun Quisling.
